AUTOANTHONYRELICS-ENABLED.title: Enable Anthony Algorithm - Relics
AUTOANTHONYRELICS-ENABLED.hover.desc: Master switch. When off: generated relics stop spawning, the reward pool returns to vanilla relics, and owned generated relics have no effect.
AUTOANTHONYRELICS-REPLACE_VANILLA_RELICS: When on: vanilla relics are stripped from the run grab bag, so every reward source (combat, chests, shops, events) offers generated relics only. Ancients, starters, Neow and event-fixed relics are always untouched.
AUTOANTHONYRELICS-ENABLE_EXTRA_EFFECT_PO: When on: generated relics may also roll card-level effects ported from Qurious Crafting Relics - give cards in your hand Retain / Sly / Ethereal, or enchant cards with Sharp / Nimble / Imbued. Off by default: vanilla relics never do this. MULTIPLAYER: this changes generation, so every player must use the same value.
How much of the relic pool is triggered relics (damage, block, energy, draw, powers, downsides) rather than passive or benefit relics. Only the ratio between the four weights matters; 100 each reproduces the default 80/15/5 split. Set to 0 to remove triggered relics entirely. MULTIPLAYER: every player must use the same value.
AUTOANTHONYRELICS-WEIGHT_PASSIVE_CORE.ho: How much of the relic pool is passive relics (hand-draw modifiers, restriction affixes) rather than triggered or benefit relics. Scales the passive band's share of the slot roll; it does NOT choose which passive wins inside the band, and the restriction pairing draw stays uniform. Set to 0 to remove the band. MULTIPLAYER: every player must use the same value.
AUTOANTHONYRELICS-WEIGHT_BENEFIT_CORE.ho: How much of the relic pool is strictly-beneficial passives (the Ancient benefit affixes) rather than triggered or passive relics. Scales the benefit band's share of the slot roll; it does NOT choose which benefit wins inside the band. Set to 0 to remove the band. MULTIPLAYER: every player must use the same value.
AUTOANTHONYRELICS-WEIGHT_EXTRA.title: Weight: Extra Pool Effects
AUTOANTHONYRELICS-WEIGHT_EXTRA.hover.des: How much the extra effect pool contributes, relative to the core pools. This one also reweights INSIDE the triggered band, since core and extra fragments are sampled together there. Ignored while the extra effect pool is off. MULTIPLAYER: every player must use the same value.
